newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rebels slaughter more than 50 villagers in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Rebels slaughter more than 50 villagers in Algeria.

text.p: Moslem guerrillas killed more than 50 villagers in Larba area south of Algiers earlier this week and four people died in three bomb attacks elsewhere, Algerian newspapers said on Tuesday.

The newspapers said the massacre, the latest in a series of killings in remote hamlets, was in retaliation against a government offensive on Moslem rebels in which up to 300 guerrillas were killed in the past two weeks.
Residents in Larba region 25 km (15 miles) from Algiers said on Monday that 44 people had died in the massacre which took place the previous night.
